This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Bruna arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, she has been observed to be fearful. Noted to head whip with an open mouth when handlers initiate contact and when a handler attempted to place a collar on her. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Bruna
